name: hpack
title: HPACK: nghttp2 vs Rust
summary: Differential + sanitizer fuzzing of nghttp2's HPACK decoder (C, the target) against a Rust HPACK decoder, over RFC 7541 representation traces that share a dynamic table. A sanitizer fault in nghttp2 or a decode disagreement is a finding; the Go x/net decoder breaks C-vs-Rust ties.
